'''Nabu''' was one of the principal [[Deity/Legends|deities]] worshipped by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]].<ref name="Nexus" /> In approximately [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Nexus of Power]]'' states that [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was discovered by the [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]] 100 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the expedition that resulted in the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], which was placed in approximately [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, Naboo must have been discovered and named by the Grizmallti around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].</ref> the Grizmallti discovered a planet in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that they named [[Naboo/Legends|Nabu]] in honor of their god. Human refugees from Grizmallt [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the world almost 100 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[3900 BBY/Legends|later]], and it subsequently became known as "Naboo."<ref name="Nexus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nabu was mentioned in ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', a [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Nexus" /> An unverified claim that Naboo was named for the deity Nabu was previously introduced on the [[Wookieepedia]] page for Naboo on [[April 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="Wook">{{WookCite|url=Naboo/Legends?oldid=3040198|text=Naboo}}</ref> Nabu shares a name with the real world [[Wikipedia:Babylon|Babylonian]] [[Wikipedia:Nabu|god]] of wisdom and writing.<ref name="Nabu">{{WebCite|url=https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/amgg/listofdeities/nabu/|text=Ancient Mesopotamian Gods and Goddesses - Nabu|author=Tudeau, Johana|archivedate=20250804025733}}</ref>
